derivation:
by
  apply Finset.coe_injective
  simpa only [Finset.coe_inv, Finset.coe_smul_finset] using Set.inv_smul_set_distrib₀ a (s : Set α)
explanation: The independent Set theorem gives the same inversion identity for arbitrary sets. Apply it to the coercion of s and transfer the equality back to finsets.
